text: opus5-21 done: patch.json (8 hunks, JS+CSS) and tests/board/theme-reset-and-pen-colour.test.mjs written. Pen now reads boardSettings.theme.accent instead of hard-coded #3fdaca (new strokes only, existing ink untouched). Reset button deletes the stored theme key rather than writing defaults back, verified byte-identical to a never-themed board. Proved RED without patch, GREEN with it via page.route on a patched scratch copy; pen-and-eraser-tools and theme-and-light-mode suites both pass unpatched against the same scratch copy too.
